title: A thought experiment
aiStatement: Unless you write it down, every conversation with AI starts from zero
analogy: Your pilot is the AI model: ten years of skill, no memory of yesterday.
agent: Each session begins with a fresh context window

you-are-the-captain.title: You are the captain
you-are-the-captain.script: Imagine you work with an AI model that is brilliant at its job, the most capable colleague you have. I will give it a picture, because we need one all the way down: you are the captain of a coastal research project, and the model is your pilot of ten years, who steers a diving robot on a cable from the control room on deck while you decide where the project goes next.

one-settled-condition.title: One settled condition
one-settled-condition.script: Your pilot has one condition, and it never changes. He forms no new memories overnight, but he keeps everything he ever learnt as a pilot, every rule of the trade. That is an AI model: what it learnt in training stays, and what you told it in yesterday's conversation is gone.
